name: Cactus Plant Flea Market x Swarovski x Nike Dunk Low 'Pure Platinum'
story_html: Designed in partnership with the LA-based streetwear brand, the Cactus Plant Flea Market x Swarovski x Nike Dunk Low ‘Pure Platinum’ delivers an opulent take on the classic silhouette. Every inch of the suede upper is entirely covered in Swarovski crystals, including the detachable double lace flaps, heavily padded tongue and oversized Swoosh, the latter borrowed from CPFM’s previous Nike Blazer collaboration from 2019.
